representation.name: ENCODE ATAC 2.2.3 container probe
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
{
  echo "PWD=$PWD"
  echo "PATH=$PATH"
  echo "GALAXY_SLOTS=${GALAXY_SLOTS:-unset}"
  echo "which cromwell: $(command -v cromwell || true)"
  echo "which java: $(command -v java || true)"
  echo "which caper: $(command -v caper || true)"
  echo "which atac.py: $(command -v atac.py || true)"
  echo "root listing"
  ls -la /
  echo "opt listing"
  ls -la /opt 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "workspace/input stat"
  ls -l "$(inputs.r1.path)"
  echo "find pipeline candidates"
  find / -maxdepth 4 \( -name 'atac.wdl' -o -name 'atac.py' -o -name 'cromwell*.jar' -o -name 'caper' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200
} > probe.txt
